verdicts.reason: A keeps the right hierarchy: the headline is large and readable, and NEW and Try It are prominent. But everything is crammed into the top 60% and the bottom ~40% is dead orange space. The bottle cap is jammed against the top edge, a stray faint circle overlaps the badge disc at top-left, and the right-aligned NEW/CTA stack doesn't share an edge with the left-aligned headline. B turns the bottle into a well-proportioned hero, but the hierarchy is inverted: the headline is shrunk to a tiny caption at the top, and NEW and Try It are tiny pills pinned to the bottom edge that sit on no shared axis. That buries the CTA and the message, and a stray circle fragment is clipped at top-left.
